content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Ph.D. in Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or a related discipline Experience: Experience in advanced molecular biology techniques Other conditions: Position is initially available for one year with possibility of extension Desirable: Prior research experience in yeast biology, synthetic biology, metabolic engineering, genome editing, DNA assembly, and/or fermentation technology

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ICGEB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 18 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ICGEB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Research Associate.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ICGEB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 18 October 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an application fee for ICGEB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for ICGEB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: As per applicable DST norms.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for ICGEB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Ph.D. in Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or a related discipline.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for ICGEB Recruitment 2026 besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Position is initially available for one year with possibility of extension.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for ICGEB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Shortlisting based on CV and cover letter. Interview for shortlisted candidates. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

faq.answer: Temporary project position, co-terminus with the sanctioned project.
